name: Vapulon
ability: Cloud Chaser / Motor Drive / Gale Wings (hidden)
look: a sleek metallic hummingbird shaped like a pod vape: a gunmetal pod with a glowing light strip, a long black mouthpiece beak, a silver plug tail, whirring wings and trailing vapor
entry: Popular among younger trainers in bustling cities, Vapulon charges itself at wall outlets and exhales massive plumes that smell faintly of artificial berries.
how: Wild: uncommon in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
Its ability Cloud Chaser fills the field with fog for 5 turns: Electric moves get stronger and non-Electric Pokémon miss more.
